claim: The Production front 'Next' is also the gloss of こんど from Lesson 9, and the hint does not choose between them.
evidence: Production front: 'Time / Next / the word on its own'. Lesson 9 card: 'こんど | Next, next time'. Both are single words, so 'the word on its own' fits either.
fix: Give the front a hint or scene that only つぎ fits (e.g. 'the next one in order, as in つぎのにちようび'), or gloss it 'Next (in order)'.

claim: 'How about you?' is the English I learned for Xさんは? and is close to いかがですか, so I cannot tell this front wants どうですか; it also does not match how the chapter actually uses どうですか.
evidence: Production front: 'Grammar & Function Words / How about you?' with no hint. Earlier cards: 'ささきさんは | How about you, Sasaki-san?' (Lesson 8 extras), 'ええ、すきです。かとうさんは? | Yes, I like it. What about you, Kato-san?' (Lesson 15 extras), 'いかがですか | How about...?' (Lesson 10). This chapter's uses: 'じゃ、にちようびはどうですか | Well then, how about Sunday?' and 'スミスさんもいっしょにどうですか | Smith-san, how about coming with us too?'.
fix: Gloss it 'How about it? (suggesting something)' and add a hint such as 'proposing a plan or a day', so it cannot be read as Xさんは?.

claim: The Production front 'Festival, event' fits おまつり (Lesson 7, 'Festival') and イベント (this chapter, 'Event') as well as たいかい.
evidence: Production front: 'Travel & Tourism / Festival, event', no hint. Lesson 7: '(お)まつり | Festival'. This unit: ibento 'Event'. Nothing on the front points to たいかい.
fix: Add a hint that only たいかい fits, e.g. 'a large organised event, as in the fireworks one', or gloss it 'Large event, tournament (as in はなびたいかい)'.

claim: The Production front 'A bit, a little' is the same meaning as ちょっと from Lesson 10, and the front gives no way to pick すこし.
evidence: Production front: 'Descriptions & Qualities / A bit, a little', no hint. Lesson 10: 'ちょっと | A little bit'. The card's own note concedes it: 'both mean "a bit, a little"'. I answered ちょっと.
fix: Add a hint that names the register the note describes, e.g. 'the more neutral, slightly formal word, not ちょっと'.

claim: 'Let's do that.' and 'Let's do it.' want different answers (そうしましょう vs しましょう) and I cannot reliably tell them apart weeks later.
evidence: sou-shimashou Production front: 'Grammar & Function Words / Let's do that.' shimashou Production front: 'Grammar & Function Words / Let's do it.' Neither has a hint.
fix: Add a hint to sou-shimashou such as 'agreeing to a plan someone just suggested (そう = that way)', and one to shimashou such as 'proposing an activity yourself'.

claim: The English 'Let's see.' is the everyday English filler for 'let me think', so the card risks teaching みましょう for that meaning; みませんか's 'Shall we see?' has the same problem.
evidence: mimashou Production front: 'Let's see.' mimasenka Production front: 'Shall we see?'. The chapter's sentences use the verb for watching: 'いっしょにサッカーのしあいをみましょう | Let's watch the soccer game together.'
fix: Gloss them 'Let's watch (it).' and 'Shall we watch (it)?', matching the sentence cards.

claim: 'Shall we do?' is not a complete English sentence, so the front reads as broken rather than as an invitation.
evidence: Production front: 'Grammar & Function Words / Shall we do?'. Its partner reads 'しましょう | Let's do it.'
fix: Gloss it 'Shall we do it? / Won't you do (it) with me?'.

claim: The note tells me the 'because' から is new and different from the 'from' から I know, but Lesson 14 already taught me から as 'because'.
evidence: Note: 'This から means "because, so" — a different job from the から you already know for "from" (Lesson 3's ..., Lesson 6's ...)'. Lesson 14 card: 'から | Because (particle)', with 'わたしはさむくないですから | [Because] I am not cold.'. The extras card x16a-omoshiroi-kara-ikimasenka does say 'contrast Lesson 14, where から trails the sentence it justifies'.
fix: Rewrite the note to build on Lesson 14: same 'because' から, now with the reason clause first and the invitation after it.

claim: The note cites 'Key Sentence 1', a book section I do not have; I learned おまつり in Lesson 7.
evidence: Note: 'ゆき (snow) + まつり (festival, as in おまつり from Key Sentence 1) = ゆきまつり (snow festival).' Ledger, Lesson 7: '(お)まつり | Festival'.
fix: Say 'as in おまつり (Lesson 7)' instead of the book's section label.

claim: Several notes point to other cards by position or talk about how the chapter is drilled, which means nothing in a shuffled deck.
evidence: ikimasenka note: 'contrast いきましょう below'; ikimashou-vocab note: 'more decisive than いきませんか above'; mimashou note: 'The chapter drills all four verbs (いく・みる・する・あう) across ます / ませんか / ましょう; this is the cell for みる.'
fix: Name the other card ('compare いきましょう, Let's go') and drop the drill-grid sentence from the mimashou note.

claim: Two notes point to other cards by position, which means nothing when cards are shuffled.
evidence: x16a-event-nanji-kara note: 'A DIFFERENT から from the one above'; x16c-kitaguchi-aimasenka note: 'The last of the chapter's four exits.'

claim: Several notes cite the book's grammar section numbers, which I do not have while reviewing.
evidence: x16a-tsugi-akihabara-event: 'The lesson's GRAMMAR 1 frame'; ks1-omatsuri: '... (GRAMMAR 1).'; ks2-eiga: '... (GRAMMAR 2).'; ks3-ikimashou: '... (GRAMMAR 3).'; ks4-tenki-kara: 'Demonstrates clause1から、clause2 (reason) combined with an invitation (GRAMMAR 4).'
fix: Drop the GRAMMAR n labels and keep the explanation; where a pointer helps, name the card (e.g. the あります 'takes place' card).

claim: 'Next Sunday' fits らいしゅうのにちようび and こんどのにちようび, both patterns I was taught, so I may not produce つぎのにちようび.
evidence: Production front: 'Next Sunday there is an anime event in Akihabara.' Earlier cards: 'らいしゅうのげつようびにそちらにいきます | I'll go there next Monday.' (Lesson 7 extras), 'こんどのしゅうまつになにをしますか | What will you do next weekend?' (Lesson 9).
fix: Add a hint such as 'using つぎ (next, in order)', or accept the alternatives in a note.

claim: 'next Sunday' fits らいしゅうのにちようび and こんどのにちようび as well as つぎのにちようび, with nothing on the front to choose.
evidence: Production front: 'Paul-san and Suzuki-san will go to the anime event next Sunday.' Earlier cards: 'らいしゅうのげつようびにそちらにいきます | I'll go there next Monday.', 'こんどのしゅうまつになにをしますか | What will you do next weekend?'.
fix: Add a hint naming つぎ, or a note that らいしゅうの / こんどの would also be understood.
